structured.answer: If I have to pick one, I'd go with Harel, the "כספי (שקלי)" track: Harel is a name I know, it says 0% מניות and 0% מט"ח, and it shows 4.25% (3 שנים). But I'm not sure that beats my bank deposit once the 0.57% fee "מהחיסכון" comes out, so before I sign anything I'll ask you and the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: Most of the buttons are words I don't know (S&P 500, עוקב מדד, גמיש, כספי (שקלי)). Only "אג"ח ממשלתי" looked safe to me, and it said only 1 or 3 tracks. I didn't press any of them and just scrolled the long list.

That's the one I was actually looking for, government bonds. But instead of a fee it says "עוד לא דווח" with a little orange warning sign, and there's no return, only "פחות מ־3 שנים". It looks new and small (5 מיליון), so I backed away from it.
I wasn't sure whether "4.25% 3 שנים" means 4.25% each year or 4.25% over all three years. And the big numbers like 26.39% on the shares tracks felt like gambling.

stuck.where: Screen 6, after six long dark screens
stuck.why: I got tired and stopped there. Every row looks the same, there's a circle with two colours in each one, and it's all numbers.

used: The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the highlighted button "קופת גמל להשקעה"
Company names in the group rows: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב
Track names I could understand: "כספי (שקלי)", "אג"ח ממשלות", "אשראי ואג"ח"
The "מניות 0%" and "מט"ח 0%" numbers next to each row
The "דמי ניהול ... מהחיסכון" column: 0.57% for Harel כספי, 0.58% for Meitav כספי
The return column, 3 שנים and 5 שנים: Harel כספי 4.25% / 3.08%, Meitav כספי 4.41% / 3.13%
skimmed: The sentence at the top about fees "שנגבו בפועל ב־2025" and data from רשות שוק ההון
The rows of the מור and אנליסט companies
The fund numbers in turquoise (8521, 15286 and so on)
skipped: All the "עוקב מדד S&P 500" and "עוקב מדדי מניות" rows
The coloured circles in every row
The link "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה"
The "?" signs and the arrows at the ends of the rows
Top menu: מדריך, השקעה במדד, חוקים וכללים
Screens 7 to 15, which I never reached
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדד / עוקב מדדי אג"ח (to me מדד is the price index on the news)
כספי (שקלי): I guessed it means money kept in shekels, safe
מט"ח and its percentages; 99% מט"ח sounded like dollars
"מניות 101%": how can it be more than 100?
"פחות מ־3 שנים" written where a number should be
"עוד לא דווח" with the orange sign
"מ־0.5% עד 0.73%": is that taken every year?
"תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול": so after the fee I get less?
"123 מקומות" and "123 מחושב" at the top
מסלול, the word they use for a track
not_found: Any comparison to a bank deposit, or a sentence saying which track is as safe as a deposit
The names of the big banks (Leumi, Hapoalim and so on)
A plain sentence saying what each track means
What the fee comes to in shekels on an amount like mine
Whether I can take the money out whenever I want

findings.what: Black background with grey writing. Even with the screen enlarged it's hard to read, and the small grey words in the column headings are hard to make out
Long screens full of percentages and coloured circles with no sentence explaining what's safe and what isn't. That made me anxious
The government bond track, the one that looks safe, has no fee and no return shown, only "עוד לא דווח" and a warning sign
Track names in English letters and professional terms with no explanation next to them
findings.where: The "במה הכסף מושקע" buttons and the track names

findings.what: "פחות מ־3 שנים" written instead of a return, underlined like a link. You can't tell what it means
Nothing compares a track to a bank deposit or says whether the money is guaranteed
I don't know whether "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת 3 שנים" means per year or for the whole three years
The circle chart in two colours that are close to each other (turquoise and yellow) means nothing to me
